title: JRPVP Pack
description: JRVR's Simple Pack For PVP To Look Nicer
body:
JRPVP is a PvP resource pack made by JRVR. It’s designed to keep the game looking clean and simple while making it easier to see during fights.

The goal of this pack is to improve the overall PvP experience without changing the feel of the game too much.

If you have any feedback or find any issues, please send it in my Discord: https://discord.gg/MZAvpJxvkw
